page.notes: Doubtful readings: "ultius[?]" in entry 27 (the printed word is hard to read, possibly "ultima"). The running head "PROBLEMATVM." is printed with a V and is given as PROBLEMATUM. Spelling changed per the u/v rule (dividi, universalem, usurpetur, ullius). The ligatures "pœna" and "perfectè" are copied as they appear. Entry 19 has a printed hyphen at the line end ("diffe-rat"), kept as printed. The digitiser's watermark at bottom right is left out.
